headline: Somany's Margin Story Gains Conviction

highlights: This growth was supported by a sharp realisation improvement (+20.1% YoY) for the Tiles segment coupled with 5.4% volume growth, while the Bathware segment posted double-digit revenue growth.
EBITDA margin came in ahead of expectation at 11.6%, expanding ~378 bps YoY, driven by higher own-plant utilisation, operating leverage and a meaningful JV turnaround from loss to profit.
Valuation & View We now project Revenue / EBITDA / PAT to expand at 11.7% / 23.7% / 41.9% CAGR, respectively, over FY26–29E factoring in a margin expansion of ~330 bps over the same period.
We believe the company's sustained growth momentum in both the segments coupled with heightened realisation offer an attractive opportunity.
valuation: Valuation & View We now project Revenue / EBITDA / PAT to expand at 11.7% / 23.7% / 41.9% CAGR, respectively, over FY26–29E factoring in a margin expansion of ~330 bps over the same period.
We value SOMC on a PE-based framework and assign a multiple of 15.0x (maintained) on FY28E core EPS of INR 48.2.
We, therefore, reiterate our 'BUY' rating on SOMC with a revised target price of INR 720/share (from INR 690/share earlier), implying an upside of 33.6% from CMP of INR 540.
